checks.title: Confirm feedback decision goal and owners
checks.instructions: Name Support source owner, Product decision owner, exact first result and excluded issue, roadmap and customer actions.

checks.title: Bind bounded feedback sources
checks.instructions: Record tenant, product, segment, period, channels, allowed quotations, privacy rule, deduplication key, numerator and denominator definitions.

checks.title: Agree on product decision policy
checks.instructions: Record issue match criteria, severity and reach definitions, counterexample rule, current commitment source, owner authority and approved action routes.

checks.title: Bind Support and Product Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect ready Feedback & Review Analyst and Product Feedback Coordinator Crews. Reuse compatible identities or propose reviewed creation with exact Crew IDs and source grants.

checks.title: Probe feedback and issue sources
checks.instructions: Read one real authorized feedback set plus current issue/roadmap state. Record stable IDs, observed times, coverage gaps and privacy scope; a named connector is not proof.

checks.title: Validate theme and Product decision
checks.instructions: Run the packaged validator on feedback-theme-brief/v1 before Product consumes it and on product-feedback-decision/v1 after current-state review. Stop on wrong scope, duplicate IDs, invalid denominator, unsupported issue match or false action claim.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, sources, artifact paths, validator steps, owner decisions, privacy boundary, action approval, duplicate key, manual route, cost and notifications.

checks.title: Run one real theme manually
checks.instructions: Use authorized feedback and current product sources. Save both artifacts, validation, owner correction or decision, and action receipts or none. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Record issue and customer action outcomes
checks.instructions: Keep recommendation, owner decision, issue write and customer communication distinct. Bind exact issue or message provider receipt only after separately approved action.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. Any schedule or authenticated feedback event needs window and theme deduplication, privacy, retries, cost and owner notification review.
